description:
SAIC is seeking a Software Engineer Associate to support the US Navy in Crane, IN . 

 JOB DESCRIPTION: 

 Candidate will serve in the Weapons Platform Integration Branch focusing on the MK49 Remoted Operated Small Arms Mount ISEA project. 

 JOB DUTIES: 

 
 Supporting all software aspects of the MK 49 MOD 0 ROSAM system and support equipment 

 Support ongoing engineering, troubleshooting, continuous improvements, and system refurbishments 

 Support live-fire test and evaluation events along with collaborating with other branches and divisions within and outside of the Weapon Systems Division (JXN) 

 Candidate should have a strong background in embedded systems and programming in Python and C++ languages 

 

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CLEARANCE: 
 Bachelor’s degree and zero years of experience
 Experience with Python and C++ languages
 Communicate well
 Work within a team to find solutions
 Document processes and provide expertise for customer feedback
 Meeting specified deadlines - position is very time sensitive with deliverable schedule
 Interim secret clearance required to start with the ability to obtain a secret clearance. SAIC will sponsor the clearance process
 US Citizenship
 DESIRED EXPERIENCE: 
 Experience with Embedded Systems (ARM is highly desired)
 Prefer degrees in computer science, computer engineering or electrical engineering
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
